item.title: Al menos 100 muertos tras derrumbarse una mina de oro en República Centroafricana

Fuente: El País - Internacional.

item.title: Manhattan’s traffic-packed Broadway is slowly becoming a 5-mile wildlife corridor
item.description: Manhattan’s Broadway medians are being replanted with native Northeast species under a long-term project by the Broadway Mall Association. The Great Green Way covers five miles of Broadway and aims to connect 83 green malls into a corridor that can support birds, bees and other wildlife. Twelve malls have been restored so far, with more planting planned through 2026. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
